external_entities.name: calling service
external_entities.description: Other teams' backends that call the inference gateway.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
external_entities.notes: Also described as 'calling services' and 'calling team'.

external_entities.name: ML engineer
external_entities.description: ML engineers who publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.notes: The source is unsure what governs who can push and suggests it may be a shared group account.

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service that receives inference requests and forwards them to the model server.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE
processes.notes: Keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The server that runs the actual model on GPU nodes and reads model artifacts and customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network
processes.notes: The source says artifact verification is not believed to occur and that the bucket is trusted.

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket holding model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.
data_stores.source_excerpt: model artifacts from a model registry bucket
data_stores.notes: The source says the model server uses its own service account and that artifact-swapping verification is not believed to occur.

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis feature store containing customer features including account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The features include account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response for debugging, including raw prompts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_stores.notes: Raw prompts sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.name: call gateway
data_flows.description: Calling services send inference requests to the inference gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway
data_flows.notes: Callers pass an API key in a header; keys are issued per calling team and have never expired one.

data_flows.name: forward request
data_flows.description: The inference gateway forwards requests to the model server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway forwards the request to the model server
data_flows.notes: There is no authentication between the gateway and the model server.

data_flows.name: load artifacts
data_flows.description: The model server loads model artifacts from the model registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.notes: The model server uses its own service account for access. The source says artifact integrity is not believed to be verified.

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from the Redis feature store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store on the same network
data_flows.data_description: customer features including account age and spend bands per customer

data_flows.name: write log
data_flows.description: The gateway writes every request and response to the inference log for debugging.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging.
data_flows.notes: The logged raw prompts sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.
data_flows.data_description: every request and response, including raw prompts

data_flows.name: publish artifacts
data_flows.description: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the model registry bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
data_flows.notes: The source is unsure what governs who can push and says it may be a shared group account.

trust_boundaries.name: GKE
trust_boundaries.description: The GKE environment where the inference gateway runs.

trust_boundaries.name: model network
trust_boundaries.description: The network containing the model server and Redis feature store.
trust_boundaries.notes: The model network is meant to be reachable only from the gateway.

trust_boundaries.name: different cloud
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud location of two calling services.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: two of the calling services are in a different cloud

assumptions.basis: The source identifies the gateway as a FastAPI service.
